acceptanceCriteria: The harness computes the preregistration digest from the committed file and refuses to run when it differs from the sealed value; PCCO-V0-015 says which digest is binding.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #87 (V1-0012 daily-loop measurement, run-001). harness.py:548 accepts the digest as an argument, so a changed preregistration can be run under the sealed digest; PCCO-V0-015 wording should name the computed digest as binding.
title: daily-loop bench: the preregistration digest is operator-supplied via `--prereg-sha256` instead of computed and pinned
